title: Floodmark Gate
description: A battered limestone gate with a raked round crown, a saddle keystone and approximately 34 m clear opening height.

review.notes: Round 3 (final, rebuilt). Fixed: the Gothic piers are gone, the arch is a clean round arch with a projecting keystone, and the voussoir surfaces are consistent. Not fixed or new: (1) the piers are now plain cylindrical drums capped by flat overhanging discs, and the arch sits on the disc like an object placed on a table; there is no impost or springer tying the arch into the pier (hero.jpg). (2) The passage floor is still a thin plate with a chamfered edge laid on the ground (closeup_base), which round 1 and round 2 already raised. (3) The voussoir joints are open black slots (closeup.jpg), not tight recessed joints. (4) Material: clean white with no weathering at the pier feet; the pebbles sit in an even ring around each pier base. Fix: square or bound piers with an impost block the arch springs from, a floor bound into a plinth, tight joints, and local dirt at the feet.
